labels.community_norm_expectation: Observable signal about field norms or shared community expectations.
labels.editorial_risk_control: Observable editor/reviewer signal about unresolved risk or revision burden.
labels.ethical_acceptability: Observable expectation for ethical, safety, privacy, or fairness acceptability.
labels.journal_scope_fit: Observable signal about journal scope, audience, contribution threshold, or fit.
labels.novelty_threshold: Observable expectation for higher novelty or stronger positioning.
labels.presentation_standard: Observable expectation for journal-quality presentation and clarity.
labels.replicability_norm: Observable expectation that findings should be replicable.
labels.reviewer_authority_pressure: Observable response pattern showing deference to reviewer authority.
labels.transparency_norm: Observable expectation for code, data, methods, or protocol transparency.
labels.unknown: No reliable institutional signal can be inferred.
